name: Yaogan 50-03
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: The Yaogan 50-03 is a Chinese military “remote sensing” satellite of unknown purposes.
slot_b_text: Low Earth orbit is anywhere from about 160 to 2,000 km up, where a satellite laps the planet roughly every 90 minutes. Everything there is falling; it just keeps missing the ground.
description: The Yaogan 50-03 is a Chinese military “remote sensing” satellite of unknown purposes.
rocket_fact: A rocket heading straight up would quickly fall back down. Orbital rockets spend most of their energy building sideways speed.
